Name: Updated XACT file (NEW.xap) for audio modding (updated for SDV 1.3 beta)
Author: PakRT
Description:
Please refer to this link for how to replace current in-game audio; procedures given in link below are still valid, but the provided "NEW.xap" file is outdated for 1.3 beta update.
[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sound-modding-tutorial-discussion-redux.127661/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sound-modding-tutorial-discussion-redux.127661/[/url]

*1.3 SPOILER AHEAD*
This mod only provides the updated "NEW.xap" as referred to at the compiling step (in link above) so that the new audio from the 1.3 winter night market is compiled into the wave bank.xwb. The new 5 audio files are:

[list]
[*]0000016a: Mermaid show full length performance
[*]0000016b: Audio prompt on the shell in the mermaid show boat
[*]0000016c: Ambient music for the winter night market
[*]0000016d: Submarine submerge/emerge sound
[*]0000016e: Ambient music when submarine is submerged
[/list]
For complete list of wavebank ID (updated up to 1.2) here is the pastebin link
[url=https://pastebin.com/C8QvXVpv]https://pastebin.com/C8QvXVpv[/url]﻿

If you are looking to add more music use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/425]Stardew Symphony by Alpha_Omegasis [/url](Always check SDV 1.3 SMAPI Compatibility list by Pathoschild [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:SMAPI_compatibility]here[/url]; at the time this is written, Stardew Symphony is outdated for 1.3)

Downloads.Description: Use this if you are on SDV 1.3 beta
